description: Extends the expiry of a vnsh workspace without changing its content. Use this when the user says a link is about to expire, or asks to keep something alive longer. Needs the edit link (a #w= fragment); a view-only #r= link cannot renew. The version is not bumped, so any pending edit still applies.

ttl.description: New lifetime in hours measured from now (max: 168). Omit to reuse the lifetime the workspace was created with.

name: vnsh_workspace_renew
